canonical_config.description: Build and initially minimize the user's original general tilt FCC Ni GB: ordered GB1 (110) || GB2 (111), local tilt directions [1 -1 0], pure-tilt misorientation 35.26438968 degrees. Spatial placement is top=GB1 (110), bottom=GB2 (111) by FCC planar density. Preserve original geometry; do not substitute descriptive Sigma9 near-CSL reference. Use x direction with vacuum (non-contiguous periodic connection), x_pbc=false, and retain periodicity-analysis follow-up.

source_metadata.purpose: Identify possible short repeat units and possible longer structural modulation in the relaxed {110}||{111}, <110>-tilt FCC Ni boundary without assuming any repeat ratio; compare candidate continuous-periodic x cells with construction mismatch and size estimates while leaving final selection to the user.

warnings: The final minimization did not meet an energy/force tolerance (stopping criterion: linesearch alpha is zero); the final structure and metrics remain available.

source_metadata.metadata_basis: registered canonical construction config; not a repeat-count prior

ptm.coordinate_frame: OVITO imported Cartesian Angstrom coordinates (CFG origin may be shifted)
ptm.method_note: PTM runs on the full input before any surface or slab filtering.

scope.crystal_indexing: FCC/BCC with resolvable low-index x; optional

limitations: Finite-window geometric and structural hypotheses, not proof of exact translational symmetry.
Nearest-atom matches are bidirectional but not a constrained bijection.
No statistical confidence probabilities or automatic Burgers-vector conclusions are assigned.
Small structures cannot exclude a longer modulation outside their observable range.

eligibility.note: Construction x_pbc=False means vacuum padding; it is distinct from LAMMPS boundary flags.

boundary.gb_y_method: largest interlayer gap within the unique interior PTM defect band
boundary.selection_meaning: Interior non-bulk PTM atoms are interface seeds, not a complete or unique physical GB definition; neighboring crystalline atoms are retained for pattern matching.

crystal_mapping.orientation_convention: OVITO xyzw quaternion; cubic symmetry aligned before averaging
crystal_mapping.index_ambiguity: Signed axis labels depend on the cubic symmetry branch; families are invariant. Original builder labels require its orientation metadata.

lower.conversion_assumptions: Local FCC/BCC conventional cubic cell with isotropic PTM scale; anisotropic strain is checked by measured actual atom translations rather than assumed absent.

upper.conversion_assumptions: Local FCC/BCC conventional cubic cell with isotropic PTM scale; anisotropic strain is checked by measured actual atom translations rather than assumed absent.

nominal_builder_comparison.mismatch_definition: absolute length difference / mean of the two lengths
nominal_builder_comparison.note: Nominal unstrained cubic lengths; distinct from relaxed measured mismatch.

nominal_builder_comparison.note: Nominal unstrained cubic lengths; distinct from relaxed measured mismatch.

registration.domain_cycles_policy: Count repetitions in the cropped physical interval, never across periodic images.

modulation_seed_search.method: Resolved scalar peaks plus up to three nonbulk xyz minima within 8% propose additional candidates; final evidence is reevaluated using the refined short scale.

local_features.meaning: Maxima of a smoothed scalar field, not identified dislocation cores.
Maxima of a smoothed scalar field, not identified dislocation cores.
Maxima of a smoothed scalar field, not identified dislocation cores.

long_modulation.short_scale_input_role: Optional measured candidate; no orientation or repeat-count prior.
interpretation_limits: No long candidate means insufficient evidence in this finite snapshot, not proof that no longer structure exists.
PTM fractions and PTM RMSD share the same atoms and are correlated evidence, not independent statistical confirmations.
Spectral-resolution intervals are not confidence intervals; zero padding only interpolates peaks.
Scalar profiles discard transverse phase; validate candidates using layer-resolved geometry and full xyz registration.
These are structural-modulation hypotheses, not identified secondary dislocations or Burgers vectors.
The supplied near-interface mask can omit extended cores; compare wider slabs before physical interpretation.
Input coordinates must already have x along the analyzed interface direction; no crystal Miller-index prior is used.
Different PTM fields can localize different crests; field-specific spacing variation alone does not establish varying defect separation.

profile_settings.rmsd_zero_handling: Zero/nonfinite RMSD excluded from RMSD numerator and denominator.
profile_settings.fraction_definition: Smoothed weighted count divided by the identically smoothed atom count.

long_modulation.reason: Retain multiple hypotheses and local intervals for geometry validation and user interpretation.

scale_partition.source: shortest supported lattice Pareto candidate; geometry fallback if indexing is unavailable
scale_partition.sensitivity_note: This split is a reported analysis policy, not proof of a unique short fundamental.

selection_rules.short: Length/mismatch Pareto lattice seeds + finite-cycle and xyz residual gates; show shortest first.
selection_rules.geometry: All-atom xyz residual order, no physical-period designation.
selection_rules.long: Generic PTM modulation evidence + nonbulk xyz match + sufficient cycles; order by nonbulk RMS.
selection_rules.hierarchy: If long candidates exist, relative short candidates must be smaller by the stated scale-separation factor; retain every admissible pairing.
selection_rules.harmonics: Annotate approximate integer multiples, never discard a supercell only because its ratio is reducible.
selection_rules.threshold_meaning: Configurable evidence/display gates, not material laws or calibrated probabilities.

lattice_filter.rule: For reduced [uvw]: FCC half-integer steps iff u+v+w is even; BCC half-integer steps iff all three are odd; otherwise integer steps. Divide by gcd for unreduced indices.
lattice_filter.scope: Filter reported pure-x lattice-repeat candidates, not measured FFT wavelengths, spatial intervals or row motifs. Compatible means necessary closure only; geometry, mismatch and user choice still apply.

multiscale_analysis.priority_reason: P012: local-repeat display score 0.961 = 0.4×row 0.999 + 0.3×strain 0.930 + 0.3×geometry 0.940. This is visual emphasis, not a unique or confirmed period.

selection_policy.meaning: Priority for review based on local repeat evidence; heuristic, not a probability or a selected physical period.
selection_policy.local_association: Within 0.3 NN; exp(-0.5*(distance/tolerance)^2). Keep maximum per grain, average over both grains; channels are correlated, not extra votes.
selection_policy.local_quality: At least 3 observations; strain relative spread <= 0.15. Prominence-stable strain modes weight 1; otherwise 0.5. Only uniformly sampled coordinate rows.
selection_policy.geometry: Mean of 1/(1+(RMS/NN/0.15)^2) for near-GB and non-bulk populations.
selection_policy.highlight_eligibility: Validated pure-x FCC/BCC lattice closure in both grains, positive local row or strain support, both finite geometry residuals, near-GB RMS/NN <= 0.20, at least 3 observable cycles when reported, and no oblique-only role.
selection_policy.tie_break: Equal score to 8 decimals: smaller physical translation first, then candidate id.
selection_policy.count_labels: Upper : lower full a[hkl] coefficients. Display a nominal enumerated pair or allowed FCC/BCC translation-grid pair only when each independently predicted grain length lies within 0.3 NN of the coordinate candidate. Otherwise prefix measured counts with approximation sign; exact measured counts remain separate.
selection_policy.indexing: Validated source orientation when present; otherwise nonnegative descending-index cubic-symmetry representatives for compact display. Original signed PTM directions are preserved in metadata; unresolved directions stay unresolved.

long_band_observability.meaning: The exploratory long-wave band requires its lower bound to be below the observable upper bound. An unresolved band does not establish absence of long periodicity.

evidence_semantics.primary_output: Present the summary image first, with the review-priority candidate and a few distinct alternatives. Read the linked detailed reports only when needed.
evidence_semantics.priority: Highest declared local-evidence review score among eligible candidates; a heuristic, not a probability or a confirmed period. If none is eligible, no priority is assigned.
evidence_semantics.short_and_long: Short atomic-row motifs, local strain intervals and full-coordinate recurrences are separate observations. A nearby lattice pair retains its own coordinate length; it does not replace the measured motif length.
evidence_semantics.spectra: Colored S/L guides are hypotheses, not inserted Fourier maxima. Actual structure and strain peaks retain review outcomes; far-field strain overlap never automatically rejects a peak.
evidence_semantics.decision: Candidates do not establish secondary dislocations or automatically select PBC dimensions. The user makes the final selection.

notes: Measured motifs and construction-only rational matches are separate evidence; constructor candidates are not measured structural repeats.
Candidate options retain source ny/nz; review listed size-policy violations and periodic seams before choosing a new model.
Only validated FCC/BCC pure-x lattice-repeat coefficients enter measured options; measured feature lengths are not arbitrary construction counts.
No model was rebuilt, strained, or selected. Allowed fractional repeats are preserved for explicit user review.
